meaning.en: An aircraft crew member in charge of loading and unloading cargo or heavy weapons.
meaning.vi: Một thành viên phi hành đoàn phụ trách việc xếp dỡ hàng hóa hoặc vũ khí hạng nặng.

meaning.en: (military) The member of an aircrew responsible for the loading and internal stowage of heavy cargo (so as to minimise the disruption of the aircraft's trim)
